live_evidence.scope_note: CI run https://github.com/altexsoft-dmytro-novyk/workplace/actions/runs/34218105827 on a workflow_dispatch of tests.yml at c305f2c. Backend unit, the complete backend e2e suite and the frontend Playwright suite all executed: 680 cases seen, 631 mapped. The e2e job's compose step exited 1 (localstack unhealthy) but is continue-on-error, so the suite still ran and reported.
live_evidence.provenance_note: The workspace was fast-forwarded to the exact commit the run observed and both submodules already sat at the SHAs that commit pins, so recorded_source_sha and current_source_sha are the same commit.

change_from_previous.note: Not a regression in verdict — a change in what the run is allowed to claim. The team override committed in c7b717d makes a whole-repository trace a planning audit with allow_gate=false; the 2026-09-06 run predates that policy and issued a gate it would no longer be permitted to issue. The inventory also grew: 30 Epic 4 requirements (ACM11-FPO, S4.1a-DP, S4.1c-SAG, S4.2a-OP, S4.2b-TR, S4.2d-DS) entered the oracle, so 258 became 288 and the previous 88% was measured against an inventory that no longer describes the product.
